question: Do dynamic centroid-based merges still improve projected predictions when achieved query-local cluster counts are equal?
scope: Query-local diagnostic only. It replaces restriction of a global partition with partition construction in the fixed exact boundary region. Do not infer performance of reusable global coarsening from this study.
partition_graph: Original fixed region with all edges incident to the two query endpoints excluded for grouping only. Inference still uses the unchanged region and per-intervention normalization. Every variant uses the same remaining merge graph and protects both endpoints.
target_clusters: max(n - floor(0.75*n), components of the allowed merge graph). Assert every policy reaches this number on every query.
selection: Same first ten validation queries per class, already inspected development data, not independent confirmation. No outcome selection or test data.
decision: Keep all results. No paper numerical updates and no replacement of authoritative exact fidelity. A positive result is a reason for further independent and end-to-end validation, not a final method claim.
